required_fix: In the clean-result claim field, change '119/2,000 = 6.0% pooled across 21 anth-token variants' to '119/2,000 = 6.0% pooled across 20 anth-token variants' (2,000 trials / 100 per variant = 20, not 21; matches the round-1 body fix and the 119/2,000 = 20*100 arithmetic).

In the experiment row claim field, change "21 anth-token variants vs 0/900 across 9 letter-similar non-anth-token controls" to "20 anth-token variants vs 0/900 across 9 letter-similar non-anth-token controls" so the claim arithmetic (20 x 100 = 2000) matches the corrected body denominator 119/2,000 and the Experimental-design dropdown wording ("the 20 anth-token variants vs 9 letter-similar controls ... 119/2,000 vs 0/900"). The figure group labels (n=21 / n=10) include canonical and /openai/ anchors and need not change.

note: Round 2: both round-1 fixes verified in body. Fisher paragraph now reads '20 anth-token variants vs 9 letter-similar controls' which closes to 20*100=2,000 and 9*100=900 (matches 119/2,000 vs 0/900). The 'These 43' overclaim replaced with '29 of these 43 are plotted', consistent with 20+9 plotted variants plus canonical and /openai/ anchors (31 rows total). SVG group labels still say n=21 and n=10 but those count rows-with-anchors and figcaption disambiguates explicitly; not a hard inconsistency.

required_fix: Two single-sentence edits inside <details id='design'>: (1) In 'pooled across the 21 anth-token variants vs 9 letter-similar controls (excluding canonical and /openai/ sanity rows)' change '21 anth-token variants' to '20 anth-token variants' (canonical is already excluded by the parenthetical; the 9-vs-10 asymmetry on controls is already correct). (2) In the BPE-prefix decomposition bullet change 'These 43 are what the primary figure plots, plus the canonical and /openai/ anchors.' to '29 of these 43 are plotted in the primary figure, alongside the canonical and /openai/ anchors.'
reconciler_decision: Codex correct on both arithmetic flags in the Experimental-design dropdown; apply minimal numeric fixes. Flag 1: figure plots 21 anth-token rows but the canonical row is one of them, so 21x100=2100 contradicts the stated denominator 2000; pooled count 119 sums exactly across the 20 NON-canonical anth-token bars in the figure, confirming the pool excludes the canonical row. The text should say 20 variants. Flag 2: the figure plots 31 rows total (21 anth-token + 10 controls), only 29 of which are non-anchor BPE-prefix variants; the number 43 is the full BPE-prefix follow-up condition count from the setup table, not the figure-plot count. Both fixes are wording-only and do not touch statistics, claim, title, or figure.

note: Verdict: needs_targeted_fix. Two factual inconsistencies that affect reader trust in the headline numbers. (1) Design-dropdown Fisher's-exact paragraph says '21 anth-token variants ... 119/2,000' but 21*100=2,100; the 119/2,000 denominator is correct only if canonical (90/100) is excluded, giving 20 variants. Either change to '20 anth-token variants (canonical excluded)' or change the denominator to 209/2,100. The SVG group label 'anth-token variants (n=21)' counts the displayed rows including canonical, which conflicts with the test-pool count. (2) The design-dropdown text says 'These 43 are what the primary figure plots, plus the canonical and /openai/ anchors' but the figure shows 31 rows (21 anth-token + 10 controls), i.e. ~29 BPE-prefix variants, not 43. Either drop the '43' claim about the figure or plot the remaining 14. Verdict: pass

Title, claim, and body are in lock-step. The title states three findings (literal-token-binding, paraphrase silence, similarity-not-predictive); the claim quantifies each (32.9% canonical pooled n=2,600; 0/100 across n=4,000 paraphrases; 119/2,000 vs 0/900 Fisher two-sided p = 2.4e-20; identical-cosine /Anth/ 0/100 vs /anthx/ 20/100); the body's primary figure, figcaption, and design-dropdown narrative back each one. MODERATE confidence label matches across title and confidence-rationale sentence, and the binding constraint (single-seed rate values, qualitative cliff robust) is stated in the exact required shape.

WandB runs are run-level URLs (d7b6d2c2, lkhyzaww) and resolve 200; the follow-up wandb gap is explicitly disclosed in-line. Sample sizes are visible throughout (n=100/condition; n=2,600 / 2,000 / 900 / 4,000 pooled). Per-variant rates are shown in the figure and the body explicitly disclaims a per-variant prediction.

Guideline compliance: three-piece structure intact (TL;DR -> primary plot -> Experimental design dropdown), first-person "I" voice throughout, no fluff transitions, no standing-caveats / additional-figures / abandoned-metric sections, single primary plot with plain-English title and axis labels (math kept in the design block), per-bar SVG <title> tooltips that decode the BPE tokenization, figcaption reports the cliff stat without duplicating it in an in-plot legend, three cherry-picked completions are labeled "cherry-picked for illustration" with the raw-completions link in the immediately preceding paragraph, confidence-rationale sentence in the canonical shape with MODERATE matching the title, parameters table at the bottom of the design block, reproducibility appendix below it.
